correctness.rationale: Independently partitioned the complement of each possible fixed 2-regular graph on nine points into triangles by exhaustive exact cover. There are 2, 6, 0 and 12 labelled covers for (9), (3,6), (4,5) and (3,3,3), respectively. In each feasible case the orbit of the displayed representative runs through exactly all covers. The Pappus representative has the classical crossed-line pattern with base triples (4,5,8), (6,3,7) and intersection line (0,1,2). Rebuilt the majority map from the block triples and enumerated all 262144 initial states for each representative, following each to its first state fixed by F squared. This reproduced all entry layers and every individual basin. The algebra follows since F squared separates into H and K, the computed fourth images consist of fixed symbols of H and K, and A and B identify these images and conjugate F to swapping two symbols. Matched shore fiber weights hold pointwise, yielding the product size for each fixed-point basin and twice the product for each two-cycle basin. The maxima four, four, three are attained; the repaired paper correctly distinguishes counts of recurrent shore symbols, periodic configurations and temporal orbits. The printed C++ histograms can be compared to the result tables but are not asserted against the tables in that file. The repair leaves all verified numeric findings unchanged and clearly labels the known Pappus row.
residual_risks: The proof is exhaustive for these exact finite maps, not for other sizes or update rules.

value.rationale: The two survivor graphs are all the remaining types at a classical small incidence size, not arbitrarily selected examples. Exact majority recurrent and transient data distinguish these highly constrained graphs even when order and degree agree, and the comparison isolates two properties unique to the Pappus baseline among the three types: no singleton fixed-point basins and universal entry by update three. Fiber weights yield a concise exact basin description future work can check against other dynamics or structural distinctions. This value does not depend on re-counting the known Pappus row as new.
residual_risks: No universal threshold for all cubic incidence geometries is implied.
